messages.text: What are the most important S-parameters capabilities for applications in Aerospace / Defense?

The passages do not provide a ranked Aerospace/Defense S-parameter list, but they support these key satellite payload/component VNA capabilities as relevant to aerospace applications [4][5].
- Group delay measurement is important for satellite payload testing because it is used to determine transmission-path phase distortions and channel band-edge distortion [4].  
- Phase measurement is important at component level because R&S ZNA is recommended for converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase measurements [5].  
- Frequency-converting DUT support is important because satellite payload component testing includes converters and mixers, and ZNB3000 and ZNA options include frequency conversion, scalar mixer, vector mixer and arbitrary frequency-converting measurements [5][14][76].  
- Gain and linearity-related S-parameter capability is important because satellite payload testing includes gain compression, AM/AM, AM/PM, ACLR, NPR and distortion measurements [4].  
- Noise figure and gain measurement capability is important because satellite payload testing includes noise figure and gain measurements, and R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level noise figure testing [4][5].  
- High dynamic range is important for measuring low-level transmission responses, with R&S ZNA specified at >129 dB dynamic range without options and up to 170 dB maximum attainable range with full 2-port correction [38].  
- Wide frequency coverage is important because satellite spurious-emissions testing needs a wide frequency range, while VNA product coverage in the passages extends to 67 GHz for R&S ZNA67 and 110 GHz for R&S ZNA67EXT [4][35][20].  
- Multiport S-parameter capability is important where DUTs require more than two ports, and R&S ZNA50/ZNA67 and ZNB3000 models are available with 2 or 4 test ports [31][35][68].  
- Time-domain and distance-to-fault capabilities are supported by ZNL and ZNB3000 options for time domain analysis and distance-to-fault measurement [49][14].  
- Pulsed-signal S-parameter capability is supported by ZNA measurements on pulsed signals and ZNB3000 pulsed source measurements options [76][14].  
- Measurement accuracy and repeatability are important because satellite test solutions need straightforward, fast, reproducible testing with high measurement performance and repeatability [6].  
- TVAC support is important because satellite payload qualification requires TVAC performance testing, while VNAs must stay outside the chamber and long cables, adapters and switches can drift with temperature changes [42].

passages.text:
R&S ZNL20 › Spectrum analysis 主要條件（摘錄）
- [[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 的 spectrum analysis frequency range 為 5 kHz to 26.5 GHz，高於 R&S®ZNL20 的 VNA frequency range 5 kHz to 20 GHz；本頁依來源分別記錄，不合併。
- R&S®ZNL20-K14 independent CW source maximum output frequency = 20 GHz。
- Second harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 13 GHz，≤ –20 dBc，typical –35 dBc。
- Third harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 8.5 GHz，≤ –25 dBc，typical –40 dBc。
- Frequency response referenced to 50 MHz，RF attenuation 0 dB/10 dB/20 dB/30 dB，+18 °C to +28 °C：10 MHz < f ≤ 2.9 GHz < 0.8 dB（σ = 0.1 dB）；2.9 GHz < f ≤ 6 GHz < 1.3 dB（σ = 0.2 dB）；6 GHz < f ≤ 14 GHz < 2.0 dB（σ = 0.5 dB）；14 GHz < f ≤ 20 GHz < 2.5 dB（σ = 0.66 dB）；20 GHz < f ≤ 26.5 GHz < 3.0 dB（σ = 0.66 dB）。
- Total measurement uncertainty 條件：signal level 0 dB to –50 dB below reference level、S/N > 20 dB、sweep time auto、sweep type sweep、RF attenuation 10 dB/20 dB/30 dB、span/RBW < 100、95 % confidence level、+18 °C to +28 °C。R&S®ZNL20：3 MHz < f ≤ 2.9 GHz 為 1 dB；2.9 GHz < f ≤ 6 GHz 為 1.5 dB；6 GHz < f ≤ 14 GHz 為 2.2 dB；14 GHz < f ≤ 20 GHz 為 2.7 dB；20 GHz < f ≤ 26.5 GHz 為 3.2 dB。

R&S ZNL20
[[R&S ZNL20]] 是 [[R&S ZNL]] 系列的 20 GHz 2-port Vector Network Analyzer，依 [[ZNL_specs_en_3607-1071-22_v1000]] Version 10.00（September 2025）標示，VNA frequency range 為 5 kHz to 20 GHz，test port connector 為 3.5 mm, male；加裝 [[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 時 spectrum analysis frequency range 為 5 kHz to 26.5 GHz。

R&S ZNL20 › Spectrum analysis option
| Code | Order No. | 名稱 / 原文說明 | 相依 / 限制 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| R&S®ZNL20-B1 | 1303.8101.02 | Spectrum analysis，for R&S®ZNL20 | devices with serial number < 101200 cannot retrofit |

With R&S®ZNL20-B1 spectrum analysis option：

- Spectrum analysis frequency range：5 kHz to 26.5 GHz。
- RF input impedance：50 Ω。
- RF input connector：see section Measurement range, Test port connector，即 3.5 mm, male。
- Attenuator setting range：0 dB to 30 dB，10 dB steps。
- Frequency resolution：0.01 Hz。
- Number of sweep / trace points：default 1001；range 101 to 100001。
- Signal analysis bandwidth equalized：standard 10 MHz nominal；f < 6 GHz with [[R&S FPL1-B40]] option 為 40 MHz nominal；f ≥ 6 GHz with [[R&S FPL1-B40]] and [[R&S FPL1-B11]] options，YIG preselector off，為 40 MHz nominal。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 測試背景
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

R&S PCB test solutions › 與既有知識的關係
- [[高頻高速 PCB 測試解決方案]] 既有內容來自 Keysight 圖像，流程是原材料表徵、材料選擇、電路板抽樣測試、大批量監控；本頁保存 R&S 簡報中的類似但不完全相同的流程詞。

R&S PCB test solutions
[[R&S PCB test solutions]] 是 [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] Slide 21 對 PCB Fabricator and System House 的 PCB / high-speed digital 測試流程摘要，涵蓋 material measurement、stackup selection、signal integrity modeling/testing、sampling testing 與 process monitoring。

[[R&S ZNA]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Network Analyzer 系列，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]]，頻率範圍從 10 MHz 延伸到最高 67 GHz。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 典型 setup 元件
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 的 TVAC test setup 可包含：

- signal generator
- RF switching matrix
- signal analyzer
- network analyzer
- multimeter
- DC power system
- laptop / PC remote operation
- test interface
- TVAC
- satellite or satellite components
- bulkhead connector interface

來源標示 TVAC setup 中距離為 10 m to 25 m。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › TVAC power sensors
依來源：

- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 與 [[R&S NRP67SN-V]] power sensors 專為 TVAC 設計，符合 European Space Agency norms。
- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 覆蓋 up to 33 GHz。
- [[R&S NRP67SN-V]] 覆蓋 up to 67 GHz。
- 兩者可進行 fast、highly accurate power measurements。
- Dynamic range up to 93 dB。
- 量測獨立於 signal bandwidth 與 modulation type。
- 可透過 power over Ethernet LAN connection 從 chamber 外控制。
- 將 sensors 直接連接至 chamber 內 satellite input 或 output，可簡化 measurement setup 與 calibration procedure。
- 將 sensors 靠近 DUT 量測，可消除 long RF cables 的需求並改善 measurement accuracy。
- Rohde & Schwarz TVAC cables 與 special LAN feedthroughs 使用 vacuum friendly materials，並已 baked 以消除 VOC 與其他 contaminants。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 測試問題
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。
- Commercial off-the-shelf test and measurement equipment 無法在 TVAC conditions 下工作。
- Spectrum analyzers、vector network analyzers、signal generators 等設備必須留在 TVAC 外部，並以長 cables 連接 chamber 內的 DUT。
- Test setup 中的 cables、adapters 與 switches 會隨 TVAC temperature changes 發生 drift。
- 在不同 temperature 下於 chamber 中完成的 calibration 不再有效。
- 移動 cables 與改變 temperatures 後，需要 regular recalibration 以確保 measurement accuracy。
- TVAC 內 calibration procedure 特別困難，因 vacuum applied 時 operator 無法進入 chamber。

台灣衛星產業鏈 R&S solution mapping › 測試語彙連結
- [[GNSS]] — GPS定位列中的角色亮點。
- G/T、NPR、Group delay — 出現在天線、系統整合商、UT 與地面站區段；可連到 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、[[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 與 satellite payload / terminal testing 脈絡。
- [[DVB-S2-S2X]] — 出現在系統整合商、UT、地面站與通訊模組區段。
- [[NB-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]] — 出現在 UT 與通訊模組區段；可連到 [[5G NTN validation and testing]]、[[CMX500 NTN one-box tester]] 與 [[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]]。
- OBC — 出現在衛星控制板區段，可連到 [[On-Board Computer]] 與 [[Satellite OBC 外部資料清單]]。
- ISL module — 出現在其他區段的 [[光紅建聖]] 列，來源未展開 ISL。

衛星酬載與元件測試
[[衛星酬載與元件測試]]是針對 satellite transponders、payload subsystems、modules 與 RF / digital components 的設計、開發、驗證與 qualification 測試集合，來源以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器方案為主。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › Payload 架構層級
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 將 satellite payload 技術演進描述為：

- Bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads。
- Digital regenerative payloads。

Bent-pipe satellite payload channel 的 high-level components 包含：

- uplink antenna
- low noise amplifier
- filter
- frequency converter
- filter
- high power amplifier
- filter
- downlink antenna
- local oscillator

Regenerative payload channel 在上述鏈路中加入：

- digital demodulator
- baseband processing and switching
- digital modulator

來源稱 regenerative payloads 可提升 system capacity 與 flexibility，但會增加 testing complexity。

The passages do not provide a ranked Aerospace/Defense S-parameter list, but they support these key satellite payload/component VNA capabilities as relevant to aerospace applications [4][5].
- Group delay measurement is important for satellite payload testing because it is used to determine transmission-path phase distortions and channel band-edge distortion [4].  
- Phase measurement is important at component level because R&S ZNA is recommended for converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase measurements [5].  
- Frequency-converting DUT support is important because satellite payload component testing includes converters and mixers, and ZNB3000 and ZNA options include frequency conversion, scalar mixer, vector mixer and arbitrary frequency-converting measurements [5][14][76].  
- Gain and linearity-related S-parameter capability is important because satellite payload testing includes gain compression, AM/AM, AM/PM, ACLR, NPR and distortion measurements [4].  
- Noise figure and gain measurement capability is important because satellite payload testing includes noise figure and gain measurements, and R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level noise figure testing [4][5].  
- High dynamic range is important for measuring low-level transmission responses, with R&S ZNA specified at >129 dB dynamic range without options and up to 170 dB maximum attainable range with full 2-port correction [38].  
- Wide frequency coverage is important because satellite spurious-emissions testing needs a wide frequency range, while VNA product coverage in the passages extends to 67 GHz for R&S ZNA67 and 110 GHz for R&S ZNA67EXT [4][35][20].  
- Multiport S-parameter capability is important where DUTs require more than two ports, and R&S ZNA50/ZNA67 and ZNB3000 models are available with 2 or 4 test ports [31][35][68].  
- Time-domain and distance-to-fault capabilities are supported by ZNL and ZNB3000 options for time domain analysis and distance-to-fault measurement [49][14].  
- Pulsed-signal S-parameter capability is supported by ZNA measurements on pulsed signals and ZNB3000 pulsed source measurements options [76][14].  
- Measurement accuracy and repeatability are important because satellite test solutions need straightforward, fast, reproducible testing with high measurement performance and repeatability [6].  
- TVAC support is important because satellite payload qualification requires TVAC performance testing, while VNAs must stay outside the chamber and long cables, adapters and switches can drift with temperature changes [42].

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 測試背景
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 測試問題
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。
- Commercial off-the-shelf test and measurement equipment 無法在 TVAC conditions 下工作。
- Spectrum analyzers、vector network analyzers、signal generators 等設備必須留在 TVAC 外部，並以長 cables 連接 chamber 內的 DUT。
- Test setup 中的 cables、adapters 與 switches 會隨 TVAC temperature changes 發生 drift。
- 在不同 temperature 下於 chamber 中完成的 calibration 不再有效。
- 移動 cables 與改變 temperatures 後，需要 regular recalibration 以確保 measurement accuracy。
- TVAC 內 calibration procedure 特別困難，因 vacuum applied 時 operator 無法進入 chamber。
